component.name: Extreme InfiniTV
component.summary: Stream live TV, movies and series

description.p: Extreme InfiniTV is a cross-platform IPTV player for Xtream Codes providers and plain M3U or M3U8 playlists. Sign in with Xtream Codes credentials, paste a playlist URL, or load a playlist file, and the app detects the source automatically.

Watch live TV with category filtering, channel search, and an inline programme guide showing what is on now and next. Replay programmes from your provider's catch-up archive, pause and rewind behind live, or seek anywhere in a full-day schedule grid. Browse movies and series in poster grids with detail pages, seasons, and episodes, and download them for offline playback.

Build custom playlists in a dedicated editor that pulls channels from any of your existing sources, or add a stream straight from a website by pasting its page URL. Embedded subtitles and audio-track switching are available for movies and series, and live channels with audio codecs the built-in player cannot decode are repaired automatically on desktop.

ul.li: Xtream Codes and M3U/M3U8 playlists in one interface
Live TV with electronic programme guide and catch-up/replay
Movies and series library with offline downloads
Custom playlists built from your existing sources
Add a stream directly from any website
Keyboard, mouse, and D-pad navigation throughout
Light and dark themes with adjustable accent color

description.p: Custom playlists get a full in-app editor, streams can be added straight from any website, and movies and series gain embedded subtitles and audio-track switching.
